title: What will Donald Trump say during Midterm Rally in Corinth, Mississippi originally scheduled for October 26, 2026? Ilhan / Omar
rules:
If 
 Donald Trump says Ilhan / Omar as part of Midterm Rally in Corinth, Mississippi originally scheduled for October 26, 2026
, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Video of the Midterm Rally in Corinth, Mississippi originally scheduled for October 26, 2026 using the live broadcast or stream.
If a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, internal & external (official) transcripts of the Midterm Rally in Corinth, Mississippi originally scheduled for October 26, 2026 will be used.

Payout Criteria
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word. 
Plural nouns occurring within proper nouns and noun phrases (e.g. names, titles, etc).
Donald Trump speaking in an official capacity.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. 
Presence alone during a livestream is not sufficient for the market to qualify (e.g., inaudible private conversations on camera, unofficial statements picked up on a hot mic).
Except as otherwise specified, previously aired content, archival footage, and recordings captured at times, places, or events wholly separate from the featured address.

Payout for cancellations and delays
If an event is definitively cancelled or the event fails to qualify under the Payout Criterion, or any other circumstance prevents normal resolution, then the market for "Event does not qualify" resolves to Yes and all other markets will resolve to No.  
If the event is postponed, and such a postponement is announced by the end of the following calendar day to be rescheduled to a time within 14 calendar days, the markets shall remain open.

blind.reasoning: Trump has attacked Ilhan Omar by name at several rallies in the past two weeks (Ohio, Iowa, Florida and at least one more), driven by a federal search of her home and claims that she used a fake name. She is a long-running target in his speeches, and his midterm remarks repeat the same material, so a mention in Corinth is very likely. The main risks are a speech focused on local issues, references that avoid her name, or disruption to the event.
blind.falsifier: A full video or transcript of the Corinth speech that shows Trump never said 'Ilhan' or 'Omar', or the rally being cancelled.

final.reasoning: The orderbook midpoint of 0.845 matches my independent estimate almost exactly. With roughly a 0.5-point gap and a 1-cent spread, neither side offers value, so I'm passing.
